title: Watersound 98 Compass Point Way
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Gulf and Dune Lake Views- 5 Adult Bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Heated Pool **Pool heating is available for this property from October 1st through May 1st for $30 per day**- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout- This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces (no overflow parking). This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Spectacular views abound at WaterSound 98 Compass Point. This stylish 5-bedroom, 8-bath home can accommodate 12 guests and boasts a private heated pool, fabulous outdoor spaces, an elevator, and access to community amenities.The home's first floor features 2 comfortable bedrooms—one with a queen bed, a private bathroom with shower, and a 43” Smart TV. The second bedroom on this floor features a queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Both bedrooms have access to a rear patio with a pool.The bright, open living area is located on the second floor. Here guests will find a very well-equipped kitchen with high-end appliances and a breakfast bar that can seat 3. Guests can enjoy their meals at the dining table with room for 8 or at the breakfast bar. The cozy living room is just off the dining area. Here you will find 2 plush sofas, and a 75” Smart TV with a soundbar—making this the perfect space to gather at the end of the day to watch the latest blockbuster or sporting event. There is an expansive deck that can be accessed from the kitchen. Here guests will find a grill, plenty of comfortable outdoor furniture, and spectacular views of the Gulf and surrounding area! Guests can rest in one of the 2 well-appointed bedrooms on this floor. The first bedroom boasts a king bed and a private bath with a shower. The second bedroom features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds—ideal for the kids in your party! This bedroom has a private bathroom with a shower and tub combo.The primary bedroom is located on the third floor. It comes replete with a private bathroom with a separate shower and tub, a 55” Smart TV, and access to a rear balcony with a spiral staircase that leads to the 4th-floor observation deck with extraordinary views, and a table and chairs. There is also a kitchenette on the third floor with a mini refrigerator.WaterSound 98 Compass Way is perfect for large groups or families. The home comes with 5 bikes so that you and your group can explore the area! Guests will also enjoy complimentary seasonal beach setups each morning, including 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella. Book your stay!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Bunk Room: Two Twin over Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubIMPORTANT INFORMATION *HOA regulations do not allow for guest Low-Speed Vehicle rentals. Additionally, bringing your own Low-Speed Vehicle onto the property is prohibited.*Walton County regulations require all doors leading to private pools to have an alarm that sounds when the door is slightly open (ajar). This alarm needs to be manually turned off when exiting the pool area. *This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.*Please note that there is active construction near this home that should conclude in December, 2026.

This stylish 5-bedroom, 8-bath home can accommodate 12 guests and boasts a private heated pool, fabulous outdoor spaces, an elevator, and access to community amenities. The second bedroom on this floor features a queen bed and a private bathroom with a shower. Both bedrooms have access to a rear patio with a pool. The second bedroom features 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds—ideal for the kids in your party! This bedroom has a private bathroom with a shower and tub combo. The primary bedroom is located on the third floor. It comes replete with a private bathroom with a separate shower and tub, a 55” Smart TV, and access to a rear balcony with a spiral staircase that leads to the 4th-floor observation deck with extraordinary views, and a table and chairs. There is also a kitchenette on the third floor with a mini refrigerator. WaterSound 98 Compass Way is perfect for large groups or families. The home comes with 5 bikes so that you and your group can explore the area! Guests will also enjoy complimentary seasonal beach setups each morning, including 2 beach chairs and 1 umbrella. Book your stay!
